items.title: 14.8.1 Hawa ke mayar par asar dalne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.8.1, printed pages 314-315.

blocks.text: Air quality par kai aham factors (awamil) ya sources asar dalte hain.

Lakri aur fossil fuels jalane se maqami (local) pollution barhti hai. Factories aur power plants fossil fuels istemal karte hain jo hawa mein SOₓ aur NOₓ jaise khatarnak pollutants chhorte hain. Gariyan CO, PM aur VOCs chhorti hain.

Hawa (wind), temperature aur nami (humidity) is baat par asar dalte hain ke pollutants kitna phailte (disperse hote) hain aur kitne ikatthe rehte hain. Agar garam hawa ki ek layer pollutants ko zameen ke qareeb qaid kar le (inversion) to air quality kharab ho jati hai.
Jangal ki aag (wild fires) atmosphere mein bohat sa dhuan aur PM chhor sakti hai. Qudrati dust storms (dhool ke toofan) air quality ko bohat gira sakte hain.
Temperature ka badalna, jaise mukhtalif mausamon mein imaraton ko garam ya thanda karna, pollutants ka emission barha sakta hai. Mausami pollen ki zyada miqdar bhi air quality kharab kar sakti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki numbering
blocks.text: Kitab mein factors ki numbering i, ii, iv, v chhapi hai (iii nahi hai); yahan bhi kitab wali numbering rakhi gai hai. Factors kul chaar hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa qudrati factor air quality ko behtar kar sakta hai? Aur AQI 51 se 100 kis darje ko zahir karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Barish (rainfall) zarron aur ghulne wali gases ko hawa se dho kar air quality behtar karti hai. AQI 51 se 100 'Moderate' (darmiyana, peela rang) hai.

items: Factors: emission sources; meteorological conditions (hawa, temperature, nami, garam hawa ki layer); natural events (wild fires, dust storms); seasonal changes (garam/thanda karna, pollen).
Table 14.2: 0-50 good (green) se 301-500 hazardous (maroon) tak chhe darje.
